edges.reason: msg.sender is read by the Owned constructor to initialise the owner state variable.
Owned constructor writes the untrusted msg.sender into the owner state variable.
onlyOwner modifier compares msg.sender to owner before transferOwnership body runs.
onlyOwner modifier gates transferAnyERC20Token on msg.sender == owner.
transferOwnership writes the staged address into newOwner.
Parameter _newOwner flows into the newOwner state variable.
acceptOwnership requires msg.sender == newOwner for privilege escalation.
acceptOwnership overwrites owner with the previously staged newOwner.
acceptOwnership resets newOwner to address(0).
FrellyToken constructor implicitly executes the Owned base constructor.
Constructor writes the symbol string literal.
Constructor writes the name string literal.
Constructor writes the decimals value.
Constructor writes _totalSupply = 1.
Constructor mints the entire supply to the deployer fixed address in balances.
totalSupply reads the _totalSupply state variable.
totalSupply reads balances[address(0)] in the subtraction.
totalSupply performs an unchecked subtraction that can underflow.
balanceOf reads the balances mapping.
Parameter tokenOwner indexes the balances mapping in balanceOf.
msg.sender is used as the debited account in transfer.
Parameter to receives the credited tokens in transfer.
Parameter tokens is the amount moved in transfer.
transfer calls safeSub on the sender balance.
transfer calls safeAdd on the recipient balance.
transfer updates the balances mapping for sender and recipient.
Parameter from is the debited account in transferFrom.
Parameter to is the credited account in transferFrom.
Parameter tokens is the amount moved in transferFrom.
msg.sender indexes the allowance mapping as spender in transferFrom.
transferFrom calls safeSub on balance and allowance.
transferFrom calls safeAdd on the recipient balance.
transferFrom updates the balances mapping.
transferFrom decrements the allowed mapping for the spender.
Parameter spender is the allowance beneficiary in approve.
Parameter tokens is the allowance amount in approve.
msg.sender is the allowance owner in approve.
approve writes the allowed mapping for msg.sender and spender.
Parameter spender is both the allowance beneficiary and the callee in approveAndCall.
Parameter tokens is the allowance amount in approveAndCall.
Parameter data is forwarded verbatim into the external receiveApproval call.
msg.sender is the allowance owner and is forwarded to receiveApproval.
approveAndCall writes the allowed mapping before making the external call.
approveAndCall invokes receiveApproval on an attacker-controlled contract, which can reenter the token.
Parameter tokenAddress selects the arbitrary contract targeted by the external call.
Parameter tokens is the amount passed to the external transfer.
transferAnyERC20Token reads owner as the external transfer recipient.
transferAnyERC20Token performs an external call to an arbitrary token contract.
Parameter tokenOwner indexes the allowed mapping in allowance.
Parameter spender indexes the allowed mapping in allowance.
allowance reads the allowed mapping.
safeAdd assigns the computed sum to local variable c.
safeSub assigns the computed difference to local variable c.
safeMul assigns the computed product to local variable c.
safeDiv assigns the computed quotient to local variable c.
